note: One thread, widest to narrowest. If a level is blank, the chain is broken there and the dashboard says so.

levels.goal: A public, agent-legible operating system for a life spent benefiting others — copyable by anyone who wants it.
levels.why: The systems worth building are the ones other people can run too.

levels.goal: Operating supercomputer of dreams and engineering singularity.
levels.why: Everything downstream derives from one accumulating point. The machine is the instrument, not the product.

levels.goal: Cockpit and public site shipped, published, and actually steering the work.
levels.why: A dashboard nobody opens is a document.

levels.goal: Dashboard public with real links; Discord cockpit live; Hermes hosted somewhere that stays awake.
Ship the transparent dashboard: horizons, settings, agent uplink, ASCII scope.
levels.why: This is the map everything else gets steered from.

levels.goal: Stand up the agent fleet and merge it into the cockpit.
levels.why: One cockpit steering everything, not two screens.

levels.goal: Align the fleet to the horizon chain so every agent serves a stated goal.
levels.why: Work that does not ladder up to a goal is motion, not progress.

levels.goal: Agent fleet: five agents self-reporting, proven able to pass messages.
levels.why: Agents that cannot talk cannot cooperate; proven beats assumed.
